shared_elements: T-shaped/anthropomorphic monolithic pillar form with broad head slab
quadruped animal shown in profile in low relief
animal placed high on the shaft just below the head
flat, outline-based low-relief carving on a plain undecorated ground
justification: Both depict the same distinctive support form \u2014 a T-shaped pillar bearing a profile quadruped in flat low relief high on the shaft, rendered as a schematic outlined silhouette against a blank ground. The decisive difference is density and content: A carries only that single isolated animal on otherwise bare faces, whereas B is covered with stacked registers of birds, a fox-like beast, small human-like figures, a zigzag band and a row of animals/objects across the head, creating relationships (superposition, flanking) that A entirely lacks.
